presentation.label: DigiHoard
presentation.summary: An echo with a 3-minute memory for the Digitone's inputs: SCAN reaches back into everything you played, and COLLECT overdubs it into a sketch.
presentation.overview: DigiHoard, by irpina, is an echo collector for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs: a delay with a memory. Everything you play goes into a 3-minute memory, always, and the echo plays from it. SCAN reaches back into the memory (by itself, now and then, or where you put it), SPREAD adds a second echo further back, six modifiers bend the echoes after the delay, inside its feedback or round the whole memory, and COLLECT turns the memory into an overdubbing sketchpad. LOOP, CLEAR and RAMP play it live, and SIZE can follow the Digitone's tempo.
highlights: A 3-minute memory of everything you play; the echo reads from it.
SCAN reaches back into the memory, SPREAD adds a second echo further back.
Six modifiers in the echo, its feedback or round the whole memory.
COLLECT overdubs the memory into a sketch; LOOP, CLEAR and RAMP play it live.
usage: Hold a track key, pick DIGIHOARD in the Mod Menu and press YES.
Play into the inputs and set VOL, RPTS and SIZE on page 1 (SYN1).
Turn SCAN up to hear echoes from further back in the memory; hold T1 to scan.
Press NO to turn DigiHoard off and get the synths back.

access.location: Mod Menu: hold a track key
steps: Use a build containing DigiHoard for the Digitone mk1 on OS 1.43 or 1.44; fxkit comes with it.
Hold a track key: the Mod Menu opens. Pick DIGIHOARD and press YES.
Play into the inputs; NO turns it off and gives the synths back.

controls.name: Mod Menu (hold a track key)
controls.doc: Open DigiHoard: it takes the audio engine and its page shows. Its Mod Menu entry also brings the page back after MIDI.

controls.name: SYN1, SYN2, FLTR
controls.doc: Its three pages: page 1 Hoard (VOL, RPTS, SIZE, MOD, SPRD, SCAN, RAMP, MIX), page 2 Secondary, page 3 Switches. Pushing a knob sets it back to its default.

controls.name: AMP
controls.doc: The mixer: the inputs' levels and pans, balance, volume and width.

controls.name: LFO
controls.doc: Two LFOs on the stock LFO page; DEST aims them at its controls or the mixer.

controls.name: RECORD
controls.doc: LOCK mode: hold a trig and turn a control to lock it on that step; FUNC + a trig clears the step.

controls.name: MIDI
controls.doc: The stock UI for the MIDI tracks while it keeps playing.

controls.name: NO
controls.doc: Turn it off: the synths and the Digitone's own effects come back.

controls.name: T1
controls.doc: Tap: tap tempo (SIZE follows it). Hold: scan, as SCAN at its top.

controls.name: T2
controls.doc: Tap: bypass. Hold: LOOP (with LTCH it stays).

controls.name: T3
controls.doc: CLEAR the memory and the echoes.

controls.name: T4
controls.doc: Tap: the modifiers off and back. Hold: WIPE while held.

limitations: While it is the active effect it owns the audio engine: the synths are silent and the Digitone's own effects are off. NO gives them back; the sequencer keeps running.
Its MIDI CCs follow the Chase Bliss Habit's published CC chart, so a controller set up for that pedal works with it. It is not affiliated with Chase Bliss and uses none of its code.
A beta from its author; not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
Its buffers use 17 MB of the Digitone's bulk memory (0x46200000-0x47300000), apart from the other effect pedals'.
Needs fxkit (it comes with it) and core 4.1 or newer, so on OS 1.44 it does not build beside KitBank 0.2.0, which builds only on the older core.

load.display: Runs in the audio render while it is the active effect, nothing while it is off
load.conditions: From the source: its render handlers process the inputs only while it owns the audio (fxkit's core_audio owner); its other handlers run on the UI side. The author's CPU readings are from the emulator only. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested DigiHoard 0.2 on a Digitone mk1 (release v0.2, 18 October 2026; built before the effects' rename, which changed only names) and checked it in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. It is still a beta. This module pins the released files.
limitations: The author's report names no OS release, date or duration: testedOn is the v0.2 release date, and 1.44 is the newest OS its files support.
Not run on a Digitone Keys.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 files, pinned unchanged, linked locally with core 5.4 and Modwerk's fxkit 0.1.0: alone, beside each of the other five effect pedals, all six together, and beside DigiHealth and DigiTables on OS 1.43; on OS 1.44 every pair but KitBank (core 2.x only). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.
